scripts.build:registry: pnpm run registry:validate && pnpm run registry:clean && pnpm run registry:build && pnpm run registry:format
scripts.check:packages: pnpm run check:package && pnpm run check:package:react-tailwind && pnpm run check:package:solid && pnpm run check:package:solid-tailwind && pnpm run check:package:vue && pnpm run check:package:vue-tailwind
scripts.changeset:release: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run check:packages && changeset publish
scripts.registry:build: (cd packages/foundation && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/foundation) && (cd packages/react && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/react) && (cd packages/react-tailwind && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/react-tailwind) && (cd packages/solid && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/solid) && (cd packages/solid-tailwind && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/solid-tailwind) && (cd packages/vue && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/vue) && (cd packages/vue-tailwind && shadcn build registry.json --output ../../website/docs/public/r/vue-tailwind)
scripts.registry:clean: rm -rf website/docs/public/r/foundation website/docs/public/r/react website/docs/public/r/react-tailwind website/docs/public/r/solid website/docs/public/r/solid-tailwind website/docs/public/r/vue website/docs/public/r/vue-tailwind
scripts.registry:validate: (cd packages/foundation && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/react && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/react-tailwind && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/solid && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/solid-tailwind && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/vue && shadcn registry validate registry.json) && (cd packages/vue-tailwind && shadcn registry validate registry.json)
